Added content versions to the loaded frames and carried them through API responses and exports. A frame without a version produces a warning.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/backend/tests/test_dataset_metadata.py) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/backend/tests/test_source_version_exports.py)

Version checks passed for unchanged files, changed files and older displayed snapshots. The live CSV, JSON and PDF checks also retained the source version used for each result.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/report-downloads/verification.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/shot-csv-final-check.json)

Added the source metadata API for the loaded datasets, including available pull dates, seasons, row counts and file versions. Missing files are returned as unavailable instead of hiding the source.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/dataset-catalog.json)

Compared the API metadata with the runtime files and checked missing files, invalid source-date records and signed-out access. Valid sources remain available when another source cannot be read.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/backend/tests/test_source_version_exports.py)

Added the source details panel to Data Explorer with loading, unavailable and retry states. The current source values are visible next to the data preview.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/app/ui/data-explorer/DatasetMetadataPanel.tsx)

The displayed source values match the metadata API. The unavailable and recovery behavior is covered by the isolated metadata fixture.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/scripts/metadata-retry-harness.cjs)

Built the separate Data Dictionary page with column definitions, units and sources. Missing definitions are marked as undocumented, and the page links to the Glossary.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/app/data-dictionary/page.tsx)

Compared the dictionary with every loaded column and checked its search and protected access. The navigation check covers both directions between Dictionary and Glossary.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

Each loaded source now keeps a SHA-256 version with its API results and downloads. Checks confirmed that changed bytes get a new version and older displayed results keep their original version.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/report-downloads/verification.json)

Added the dataset endpoint with source, recorded pull date, seasons, row count and file version. Its values match the six loaded datasets; the old Synergy pull date stays unknown because it was not recorded.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/dataset-catalog.json)

Data Explorer now shows the source details beside the preview. The deployed panel matches the API: 47,982 source rows across six seasons, with the original pull date shown as unrecorded. The panel stayed visible during metadata errors and recovered when Retry was clicked.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

Added a separate Data Dictionary with definitions, units and sources for the loaded columns. Search works, and unknown columns stay visible as undocumented. Both links between Dictionary and Glossary were checked.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

Rebuilt the shot data from a new ESPN/hoopR snapshot because the historical raw file was unavailable. The 1,370,434 rebuilt shots have valid opposing teams; 600 event samples matched the provider data. A fresh Toronto export also passed the team checks.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/shot-repair/rebuild-validation.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/shot-repair/source-manifest.json)

Gameplan now uses the newly parsed situation on the first Build. The first and second builds both used Q4, 28 seconds and a five-point deficit, with the same three rankings.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/tests/gameplan-context.test.ts)

Supported coaching conditions now reach the ranker and change the documented scoring inputs. Unsupported instructions are shown as notes only, and invalid API values are rejected.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

Overtime now stays overtime from parsing through the displayed result and ranking request. The clock is limited to five minutes, and the API rejects a longer overtime clock.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

Shot metrics and analysis now load saved results, so opening the pages does not retrain a model. The deployed metrics request returned in about 0.4 seconds and the page showed the saved folds and later-season comparison.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

Shot Plan now loads for analysts. Toronto against Boston in 2021–22 returned five shot types and five zones, with a heatmap for the same filters.

Shot Heatmap and the role checks also passed. Verification.

Updated Shot Statistical Analysis to match the current API response. The page now renders the dataset and analysis sections without crashing, and does not display statistics the backend did not calculate.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

Baseline explanations now state that score, period and clock were not used. Context explanations show the situation actually supplied; the deployed baseline and context pages both passed the check.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

Added a separate readiness endpoint. Missing data or authentication settings now return a clear not-ready response naming the missing requirement, while liveness still reports that the process is running. Isolated missing-configuration checks and deployed readiness passed.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/security/readiness-isolated-processes.json)

The shot schema check now separates mapped, optional, ignored and missing required columns. Extra metadata is reported without being treated as a model feature, and missing required fields still fail clearly.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/shot-repair/column-checks.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/backend/tests/test_shot_repair_contracts.py)

Recovered pre-shot score margins from the replacement event source and stopped treating missing margins as tied scores. The saved evaluation uses finite inputs and a separate 2025-26 holdout. The model evaluates a proposed shot location and type; pre-possession prediction remains separate follow-up work.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/shot-repair/rebuild-validation.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/shot-repair/model-evaluation.json)

The rebuilt dataset has no self-opponents or one-team complete game groups. A fresh analyst export contained 5,000 Toronto 2025-26 shots with no self-opponents.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/shot-repair/rebuild-validation.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/shot-csv-final-check.json)

The first Build used Q4, 28 seconds and margin -5. Building again without changing the inputs returned the same rankings and values.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/tests/gameplan-context.test.ts)

Need-three and switching conditions reached the ranking request and changed the documented scores. Unsupported instructions remained visible as notes only.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

The overtime example kept period 5, 60 seconds and margin -2 through Build and the displayed result.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/tests/gameplan-context.test.ts)

The analyst Shot Plan loaded five shot types and five zones for TOR/BOS 2021-22, with a heatmap based on 376 matched shots. The required API requests succeeded.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

The analyst Heatmap rendered 352 matched shots for TOR/BOS 2025-26. The API returned the image successfully.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

The default metrics request loaded saved results in about 0.4 seconds. The page displayed five-fold results and the separate 2025-26 comparison without starting training.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

Shot Statistical Analysis rendered the 200,000-shot sample, 7,739 games and six seasons without a client crash. Method details and available statistics matched the returned response.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

Preview and CSV versions matched the loaded source. The CSV, JSON and PDF report checks retained their result versions, and the older-snapshot fixture kept its original version.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/report-downloads/verification.json)

Data Explorer matched the source API: 47,982 play-type rows, six seasons and the same version. The historical Synergy pull date remains unknown; the replacement shot source has a recorded retrieval date.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

The panel stayed visible when metadata was unavailable. Retry restored the three-row fixture source, and missing or corrupt optional files did not hide the valid source.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/scripts/metadata-retry-harness.cjs) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/metadata-retry/events.json)

Every loaded column appears with its definition, unit and source. Searching MARGIN returned the two matching definitions, and the Dictionary and Glossary links worked in both directions.

The API accepted period 5 at 300 seconds and rejected 301 seconds. Gameplan kept the overtime period and the five-minute clock limit.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

Supported need-three input changed the ranking scores. Invalid API inputs returned 422, while the unsupported foul-game instruction was shown as a note that did not affect ranking.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json)

The call labels matched the first displayed result in Matchup, Context and Gameplan. The label disappeared during Build; fixture checks covered changed order, empty results and stale results.

[Verification](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json) · [Details](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/tests/top-pick-call.test.tsx)

Simplified Data Explorer and the shot result pages so the main result is easier to find, with technical details in expandable sections. The shot pages now offer the saved five-fold evaluation. The first CSV link failed to save a file; after the fix, a fresh download contained all three displayed models and the matching source version.

[Browser checks](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/browser-checks.json) · [Saved CSV check](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/browser/shot-metrics-csv-check.json)

All 10 linked cases now show Pass. The new source-version, metadata and dictionary checks are complete, including unavailable metadata and retry.

[API checks](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/live-api-final/results.json) · [Metadata retry](https://github.com/Basketball-Capstone-25/NBAPlayRanker/blob/d161f42/docs/iteration-17/verification/metadata-retry/verification.json)

after.title: Access Stored Datasets
Validate Second Dataset and Models
Shot features are complete and available before possession
Fall 2026 elaboration regression tests
Shot data uses different shooting and opposing teams
Gameplan uses the new situation on the first Build
Gameplan forwards supported coaching conditions to ranking
Gameplan preserves overtime from the parsed situation
Analyst Shot Plan page can use its required API
Analyst Shot Heatmap page can use its required API
Shot Model Metrics completes within its request limit
Shot Statistical Analysis renders the returned response
API results and downloads keep the source version
Dataset metadata matches the loaded files
Missing metadata stays visible and does not hide valid sources
Data Dictionary explains the current columns
Overtime accepts a five-minute clock and rejects longer input
Unsupported coaching inputs cannot silently alter rankings
The call label uses the first displayed ranked play
Tag every loaded data file with a version number so results can be traced to the exact data used
Backend: return each dataset’s pull date, seasons covered and row counts
Data Explorer: show each dataset’s pull date, seasons covered and row counts
Create a separate Data Dictionary page that explains every data column
Fix shots credited to the wrong team in the shot data, then rebuild the shot dataset
Gameplan: use the newly entered game situation the first time Build is clicked
Gameplan: send typed coaching conditions (e.g. "need a three") to the ranking, not just the numbers
Gameplan: keep overtime as overtime instead of changing it to the 4th quarter
Shot model pages: load saved results instead of retraining the model on every visit
Fix analysts getting "access denied" on the Shot Plan and Shot Heatmap pages
Fix the Shot Statistical Analysis page to use the backend’s current data fields
Baseline explanations: say when score, period and clock were not used
Backend: give a clear "not ready" message naming what is missing (data file or settings)
Data checks: warn when the shot data has columns the app does not recognise
Shot data: handle missing score margins and state when predictions can be made
Agree how fast Top-K recommendations must load, and confirm the app meets it
Run the Top-K response-time acceptance cases
Add content versions to loaded datasets and exports
Test dataset versions and export traceability
Expose dataset source details through the API
Check metadata against the loaded files
Show dataset details in Data Explorer
Verify the dataset details panel
Build the Data Dictionary page
Check dictionary coverage and navigation
Simplify Data Explorer and shot results after stakeholder feedback
Evaluate shot forecasts using only pre-possession inputs

notes: Earlier failed executions and comments are preserved.
SCRUM-544 comment11321 retained its inline screenshot and gained the verification link.
The shot prediction contract remains conditional on a supplied shot type and location; BST-117/SCRUM-641 remain open.
